timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is an image of Joe Biden before Draggan and this is him after using Draggan.
This was accomplished in less than 2 minutes. Don't believe me, check it out in the link below for yourself.
Now you might be wondering, what is Draggan? Well, Draggan is a machine learning software developed by the Max Planck Institute for Informatics,
MIT, University of Pennsylvania and Google. The GAN in Draggan stands for Generative Adversarial Networks,
which is a machine learning framework for Generative AI. Its purpose is to create new data instances
that resemble your training data. For example, GANs can create images that look like photographs of
human faces, even though the faces do not belong to any real person. It allows you to precisely drag
any part of a picture to exactly where you want it. As you can see in this video of a cute dog
where we can add a red dot and a blue dot and a picture starts to realistically move to our desired
destination. It consists of two main components, motion supervision and point tracking.
Motion supervision guides the point you are moving towards the target position, giving you control over
its movement. On the other hand, point tracking utilizes special features to track the point you
are manipulating, helping it understand its location. So think twice if you are planning to buy a
photoshop. Draggan is something worth paying attention to. Unfortunately, I can't provide a detail
explanation of the inner workings as it's still a new development and the paper has recently
been published. However, the GitHub repo of their code says that it will be released in June.
Feel free to check out the paper I have given a link for it in the description.
Although there isn't a devmo available for draggan at the moment, hopefully a working demo
will be released soon. So stay tuned and subscribe to my channel if you found this video interesting.
Thank you for watching.

youtube_description:
Link to the paper: https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/DragGAN/

Welcome to our YouTube video showcasing the incredible power of DragGAN, the latest breakthrough in AI and machine learning. In this video, we dive into the fascinating world of image generation and manipulation using DragGAN, a cutting-edge technology developed by the University of Pennsylvania, Google, Max Planck Institute for Informatics, and MIT.

Discover how DragGAN leverages the capabilities of artificial intelligence and machine learning to give you precise control over any image. Witness the transformation of Joe Biden before and after DragGAN in less than 2 minutes! You won't believe your eyes!

Learn about the inner workings of DragGAN, which is based on the revolutionary concept of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). GANs are at the forefront of generative AI, enabling the creation of lifelike images that resemble real photographs.

Join us as we explore the two main components of DragGAN: motion supervision and point tracking. Understand how motion supervision guides points within an image towards a target position, while point tracking uses special features to keep track of the manipulated points.

While we can't delve into all the technical details in this video, we encourage you to check out the recently published paper by the Max Planck Institute for Informatics for an in-depth understanding of DragGAN's capabilities.

Stay tuned for updates as DragGAN evolves, and a working demo becomes available. The future of AI-driven image manipulation is here, and it's mind-blowing!
